resources.string: Copy one file or a whole folder (source stays put): streaming copy keeps memory flat and preserves mtime; never overwrites — a name clash with different content gets a suffix. A confirmation card appears before each run.

Batch-move files matching a rule (extension/type/date/size) from one folder into a target: same-volume rename is atomic; cross-volume copies keep sources and log them to the pending-delete list (never auto-deletes); never overwrites. Preview the plan first, then run.
Batch-copy files matching a rule (extension/type/date/size) into a target folder: sources all stay put, mtimes preserved; never overwrites. Preview the plan first, then run.

Sort a folder into subfolders (by type: photos/videos/audio/docs/archives/others, or by modified month): preview first, then run; a receipt records what went where so it can be undone in one step; never overwrites; save the rule as a tidy skill to replay later.
Read-only preview: feed the tidy/bulk-move/bulk-copy parameters and get a full source → target plan, touching nothing and needing no confirmation. Look first, run after approval.
